initialization: Both arms start from untouched original base and identical freshly initialized LoRA; never inherit B/v4 task adapter.
system: Extract all geological study sample, grain, spot or analysis identifiers explicitly written in the input. Copy the original spelling exactly, deduplicate by first entity occurrence, and return only {"entity_ids": [...]}. Do not infer parent names, join prefixes or complete missing sequences. Exclude database record indices, references, figure/table numbers, ages, isotope ratios, coordinates, instruments and reference materials. Do not classify sample versus spot. 仅识别文中实际出现的样品、颗粒、测点或分析编号，原样复制并去重；不分类、不拼接、不续号。仅输出entity_ids字段的JSON对象。

CPT.loss: Causal next-token loss on every raw-text target token including EOS; first token prefixed by EOS, subsequent chunks carry prior token. No chat template, no ID labels, no cross-document packing, every article token covered exactly once as target.
CPT.validation_selection: Up to4 evenly spaced whole sequences per article, fixed before training.

SFT.loss: Answer-only cross entropy; identical complete-document input order, labels and dropout seed reset each arm.

optimizer: AdamW, weight_decay=0, fresh optimizer for SFT in both arms
evaluation: Same19 previously inspected complete articles, identical union prompt, greedy/no thinking,4096 output tokens; incomplete labels. No test-dependent checkpoint choice.
checkpoint_selection: Fixed final CPT epoch and fixed final72-update SFT; no best-on-test selection.

data_manifest.data_selection: Fixed SHA256 source order;8 independent language-model validation articles; first128 remaining eligible sources. One CPT epoch, not chosen on extraction test scores.
data_manifest.projection: Original DOCX body paragraphs, tables and Office Math text retained; no new OCR, no aggressive cleanup, no synthetic contexts.
data_manifest.evaluation: Previously inspected19 complete articles; regression comparison, not a new blind benchmark.
data_manifest.training_route: Same untouched original Qwen3.5-0.8B and identical fresh LoRA init. direct_sft versus cpt_then_sft. Identical complete64-article SFT schedule and prompt both arms.
data_manifest.runner_limits: CPT sequence2048 tokens; one epoch. Complete SFT articles never truncated.
